name: seated pike compression lift
description: Seated with straight legs, you place your hands beside your knees and lift both heels off the floor. It trains the hip flexors and abs for L-sits and press handstands.
instructions: Sit tall with your legs straight and together.
Place your hands flat on the floor beside your knees or shins.
Lean your chest toward your thighs and keep your knees locked.
Lift both heels a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold for a moment, then lower with control.
